config.sqlTemplate: SELECT round(sum(active_ms) / greatest(dateDiff('millisecond', greatest($__fromTime_ms, min(minute_start)), least($__toTime_ms, max(minute_start) + toIntervalMinute(1))), 1), 6) AS avg_concurrency FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'all dimensions' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters

SELECT round(sum(active_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS viewer_hours FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'all dimensions' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters

SELECT sum(sessions_started) AS intervals_started FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'all dimensions' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters

SELECT $__timeInterval(minute_start) AS ts, platform, round(sum(active_ms) / ($__interval_s * 1000.0), 2) AS avg_concurrent FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'all dimensions' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY ts, platform ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(minute_start) AS ts, video_type, round(sum(active_ms) / ($__interval_s * 1000.0), 2) AS avg_concurrent FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'all dimensions' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY ts, video_type ORDER BY ts

SELECT category, round(sum(active_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS viewer_hours FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'all dimensions' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY category ORDER BY viewer_hours DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT title, video_type, category, round(sum(active_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS viewer_hours, sum(sessions_started) AS sessions, round(sum(active_ms) / nullIf(sum(sessions_started), 0) / 60000.0, 1) AS avg_minutes_per_session FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'all dimensions' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters AND title != '' GROUP BY title, video_type, category ORDER BY viewer_hours DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT max(minute_peak) AS exact_peak FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'total' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime)
SELECT dateDiff('second', max(watermark_ts), now64(3)) AS lag_seconds FROM __DATABASE__.serving_watermark FINAL WHERE layer = 'minute'

SELECT argMax(minute_start, minute_peak) AS peak_minute, max(minute_peak) AS exact_peak, round(max(active_ms) / 60000.0, 2) AS avg_concurrency_that_minute FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE grouping = 'total' AND ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) HAVING count() > 0

SELECT grouping, dim_values, max(minute_peak) AS exact_peak, argMax(minute_start, minute_peak) AS peaked_at, round(sum(active_ms) / 3600000.0, 2) AS viewer_hours, count() AS rows_read FROM __DATABASE__.serving_minute_current WHERE ($__timeFilter(minute_start) AND minute_start < $__toTime) AND $__filters GROUP BY grouping, dim_values ORDER BY exact_peak DESC LIMIT 60

config.markdown:
**Lagged layer** · `serving_concurrency_minute` · 1-minute grain · published 5 minutes behind the ingest watermark · whole UTC days swapped in via `REPLACE PARTITION`.

The lag lets the late-arrival window close: 7.0% of rows arrive out of order and within-session lateness reaches p99 2.3h. No short watermark makes the live layer exact, hence two layers.

**Additivity decides the layout.** `active_ms` is additive across every dimension, so `sum(active_ms) / window` is exact under any filter — every *Filterable* tile is built on it. A peak is additive across nothing: two platforms reach their maxima at different instants. Exact peaks therefore exist only at groupings that were precomputed, which is what *Peak grouping* selects.

Reference, hot hour 2026-07-26 10:00–11:00Z: peak **2,305**, average **855.578199**, from 31,947 intervals across 10,848 sessions. `make rollup-check` asserts these.

`audio_language`, `subtitle_language` and `player_version` are absent by design — they change mid-session (8,796 / 2,980 / 1,600 sessions), so pinning a session to one value would move active time between slices.
